name: add_exercise_catalog_filter_identifiers
query: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.get_my_exercise_catalog(uuid,uuid,uuid,text); CREATE FUNCTION public.get_my_exercise_catalog(p_subject_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,p_chapter_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,p_lesson_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,p_difficulty text DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS TABLE(exercise_id uuid,title text,statement text,exercise_type text,difficulty text,estimated_duration_minutes integer,display_order integer,subject_id uuid,subject_name text,chapter_id uuid,chapter_title text,lesson_id uuid,lesson_title text,attempt_count bigint,last_percentage numeric,best_percentage numeric,last_status text) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$ SELECT e.id,e.title,e.statement,e.exercise_type,e.difficulty,e.estimated_duration_minutes,e.display_order,e.subject_id,s.name,e.chapter_id,c.title,e.lesson_id,l.title,COALESCE(a.attempt_count,0),a.last_percentage,a.best_percentage,a.last_status FROM public.exercises e JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id=e.subject_id JOIN public.chapters c ON c.id=e.chapter_id JOIN public.lessons l ON l.id=e.lesson_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*)::bigint AS attempt_count,(array_agg(ea.percentage ORDER BY ea.started_at DESC))[1] AS last_percentage,max(ea.percentage) AS best_percentage,(array_agg(ea.status ORDER BY ea.started_at DESC))[1] AS last_status FROM public.exercise_attempts ea WHERE ea.exercise_id=e.id AND ea.user_id=auth.uid()) a ON true WHERE public.can_access_exercise_for_current_student(e.id) AND (p_subject_id IS NULL OR e.subject_id=p_subject_id) AND (p_chapter_id IS NULL OR e.chapter_id=p_chapter_id) AND (p_lesson_id IS NULL OR e.lesson_id=p_lesson_id) AND (p_difficulty IS NULL OR e.difficulty=p_difficulty) ORDER BY e.display_order,e.title; $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.start_exercise_attempt(p_exercise_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE(attempt_id uuid,exercise_id uuid,status text,started_at timestamptz) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$ BEGIN IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT public.can_access_exercise_for_current_student(p_exercise_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cet exercice n’est pas disponible pour votre profil scolaire.'; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.exercise_questions WHERE exercise_id=p_exercise_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cet exercice ne comporte pas encore de question.'; END IF; RETURN QUERY INSERT INTO public.exercise_attempts(user_id,exercise_id) VALUES(auth.uid(),p_exercise_id) RETURNING id,exercise_attempts.exercise_id,exercise_attempts.status,exercise_attempts.started_at; END; $$; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_my_exercise_catalog(uuid,uuid,uuid,text) FROM PUBLIC,anon; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.start_exercise_attempt(uuid) FROM PUBLIC,anon; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_my_exercise_catalog(uuid,uuid,uuid,text) TO authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.start_exercise_attempt(uuid) TO authenticated;
